text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting solid single-digit gains despite an Extreme Fear reading, suggesting selective buying into weakness rather than broad conviction. Bitcoin's dominance near 56% combined with modest volume ($88B) indicates cautious accumulation without euphoria, while Ethereum's 4% gain keeping pace signals that risk appetite isn't entirely shutdown. The Fear & Greed index uptick over the past week implies sentiment may be bottoming, though the extreme reading still reflects underlying doubt about the broader crypto environment.
